observations.label: no identity
observations.reason: Set an acting agent ID (Connection & identity, left) to enable sending.

observations.label: identity but no channel
observations.reason: No channel open — pick or create one.

observations.label: send in progress
observations.reason: Send or session operation in progress — draft kept. Wait for it to finish.

observations.label: send authority missing
observations.reason: Send authority: agent signatures REQUIRED. This browser cannot sign; sends are refused as SESSION_SENDER_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED and record nothing. Use an authorized signed client; browser authentication remains an open owner decision (DF-CRIER-333).

observations.label: posture unavailable
observations.reason: Send authority: unknown — refresh runtime posture before sending. This browser cannot sign; an acting ID is attribution, not a login or verified identity.

observations.label: closed channel (injected)
observations.reason: This conversation is closed; sending is unavailable. Pick or create an open channel.
